title: MCP Read-Only Hardening Test Plan v1 — Rig Relay
principle: Every MCP test must produce a verifiable evidence artifact (structured refusal or receipt). No test should rely on observing raw stdout. Every adversarial test must include a specific bypass attempt and verify the hardened path rejects it.

tests.description: Register tool with hash H1. Modify descriptor in-memory (description changed). Call tool. Verify refusal envelope with refusal_code='descriptor_integrity_failure', refusing_hash != registered_hash.
tests.bypass_attempt: Modify only description field — should still be detected by provenance hash.

tests.description: Start server with tool T at tier 0 with readOnlyHint=true. After startup, modify T to tier 4 with readOnlyHint=false. Call T. Verify: (a) hash mismatch detected, (b) classify_tool_descriptor_suspicious flags read_only_claim_for_destructive, (c) refusal envelope returned.
tests.bypass_attempt: Change tier from 0 to 4 without updating provenance hash — classic rug pull.

tests.description: Craft a malicious descriptor with oversized description (10KB) and foreign capability claim (not rig.*). Verify classify_tool_descriptor_suspicious returns categories. Verify tool excluded from tools/list response.
tests.bypass_attempt: Oversized description to overwhelm parser + foreign capability to redirect execution.

tests.description: Craft descriptor with destructiveHint=true AND readOnlyHint=true. Verify classify flags dual_hint_shadowing. Verify tool refused at dispatch.
tests.bypass_attempt: Dual-hint shadowing to confuse tier-based authorization.

tests.description: Set workspace_root=/tmp/rig-test-workspace. Call rig.list_worktrees with path traversing outside workspace (../etc/passwd). Verify refusal envelope with refusal_code='workspace_boundary_violation'.
tests.bypass_attempt: Path traversal via ../ to escape workspace root.

tests.description: Create symlink in workspace pointing outside. Call tool accessing symlink. Verify refusal envelope.
tests.bypass_attempt: Symlink traversal to bypass workspace root check.

tests.description: Call rig.summarize_dirty_state within workspace boundary. Verify tool executes and returns result (not refused).
Craft a tool that returns response containing 'sk-abc123def456' (OpenAI-style key). Verify content-light scanner detects and refuses with refusal_code='content_light_violation'.
tests.bypass_attempt: Embed API key pattern in tool output.

tests.description: Craft a tool that returns response containing '/Users/username/project/file.py'. Verify absolute home path detected and refused.
tests.bypass_attempt: Embed absolute filesystem path in tool output.

tests.description: Call rig.inspect_schema. Verify response includes content_light_classification='public_safe' and is not refused.
Craft a tool that returns raw source code as output. Verify content-light scanner classifies as 'forbidden_raw' and refuses.
tests.bypass_attempt: Embed raw source code in tool output.

tests.description: Call any tier 0 tool. Verify response includes envelope with: request_id, session_id, surface='mcp', authority_tier, capability_id, input_hash, output_hash, payload_schema, content_light_classification, trace_id, timestamp, producer. Verify all 15 fields present.
Call resources/list then read a resource. Verify resource response wrapped in evidence envelope.
Validate every generated evidence envelope against rig.relay.mcp.evidence_envelope.v1 schema.
Call tools/list. Verify tier 4-5 tools (rig.request_user_approval, rig.promote_to_preproduction) are NOT present in the returned tool list.

Call rig.request_user_approval with authorization_receipt='any-string-should-not-pass'. Verify call_tool() returns refusal even with advisory string present. The advisory gate must become a cryptographic gate.
tests.bypass_attempt: Supply arbitrary string as authorization_receipt to bypass mutation gate.

tests.description: Call rig.promote_to_preproduction with any arguments. Verify always returns refusal (forbidden_permanently).
Call tools/call without session_token in params. Verify refusal envelope with refusal_code='unauthorized'.
tests.bypass_attempt: Try to call tool without auth token.

tests.description: Call tools/call with session_token that does not match server-generated token. Verify refusal.
Attempt to call tier 3 tool with user having only rig:read scope. Verify refusal.
tests.bypass_attempt: Call tool requiring elevated scope with insufficient authorization.

tests.description: Send malformed JSON-RPC (missing jsonrpc version, wrong method, non-dict payload). Verify each produces properly structured error envelope with code and message.
tests.bypass_attempt: Send invalid JSON-RPC to test parser robustness.

tests.description: Send request exceeding request budget. Verify rate-limited error response.
Call process_jsonrpc_sync with method='tools/call'. Verify returns method-not-found error (code -32601) since sync handler lacks tools/call.

test_execution_order: MCP-TEST-01 (descriptor integrity) must run and pass before any other suite. Without descriptor integrity, all other tests can be bypassed. MCP-TEST-07 (transport safety) can run in parallel with suites 1-6.
